The presence of a final score of 0.6477 indicates a plausible but not certain mechanistic link, supported by the sequential targeting of hyoscyamine to the cGMP 3',5'-cyclic phosphodiesterase subunit gamma, which in turn targets the Proteasome subunit beta type-5.
